name: PAN-OS Allowed Inbound Administrative Access
description: Detects allowed inbound administrative access using initial flow events only to avoid duplicate start/termination alerts.
note: Created for the current Security Onion PAN-OS schema.
author: SecurityOnion
query: event.dataset:"panw.panos" and panw.panos.type:"TRAFFIC" and panw.panos.action:allow and event.action:flow_started and destination.port:(22 or 23 or 135 or 139 or 445 or 3389 or 5985 or 5986) and not source.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16) and destination.ip:(10.0.0.0/8 or 172.16.0.0/12 or 192.168.0.0/16)
